description: Batch vulnerability query against OSV.dev (up to 1000 entries per call) — for SBOM-style "scan every dependency in this lockfile" workflows. Pass an array of {package:{name,ecosystem}, version?} or {commit} entries. Returns the vuln IDs matched per query (use get_vulnerability for full detail per ID). Keyless.

queries.description: Up to 1000 query objects. Each: {package:{name,ecosystem}, version?} or {commit}.

name: query_batch

results.description: Batch query results (one per input query)

title: Query Batch
